Title: Login with valid standard user
Steps: Enter standard_user and secret_sauce; click Login
Expected Result: User is redirected to Products page

Title: Login with locked out user
Steps: Enter locked_out_user and secret_sauce; click Login
Expected Result: Clear locked-out error is displayed; user stays on login page

Title: Login with invalid password
Steps: Enter standard_user and an incorrect password
Expected Result: Authentication error is displayed

Title: Login with unknown username
Steps: Enter an unknown username and secret_sauce
Expected Result: Authentication error is displayed

Title: Submit empty login form
Steps: Leave username and password empty; click Login
Expected Result: Username required validation is displayed

Title: Submit password only
Expected Result: Username required validation is displayed

Title: Submit username only
Expected Result: Password required validation is displayed

Title: Password is masked
Expected Result: Password characters are masked

Title: Login error can be dismissed
Expected Result: Error banner disappears

Title: Problem user inventory renders
Expected Result: Inventory page loads; visually inspect product images and controls for anomalies

Title: Performance glitch user can login
Expected Result: User reaches inventory; record load duration and failures

Title: Products page lists six products
Expected Result: Exactly six products are displayed

Title: Product detail opens
Expected Result: Correct product detail page and information are shown

Title: Sort products A to Z
Expected Result: Product names are in ascending alphabetical order

Title: Sort products Z to A
Expected Result: Product names are in descending alphabetical order

Title: Sort price low to high
Expected Result: Prices are in ascending numeric order

Title: Sort price high to low
Expected Result: Prices are in descending numeric order

Title: Add one product to cart
Steps: Click Add to cart on one product
Expected Result: Cart badge displays 1; button changes to Remove

Title: Add multiple products
Expected Result: Cart badge displays 2

Title: Remove product from inventory
Steps: Click its Remove button on inventory page
Expected Result: Cart badge decrements and item is removed

Title: Cart displays selected product
Preconditions: At least one product is in cart
Expected Result: Correct product name, price and quantity are shown

Title: Remove item from cart
Expected Result: Item disappears and cart count updates

Title: Continue shopping from cart
Expected Result: User returns to inventory and cart state is retained

Title: Checkout with empty cart
Steps: Open cart and inspect checkout control; attempt checkout if enabled
Expected Result: Empty-cart behavior is consistent and no order is created

Title: Checkout requires first name
Steps: Start checkout; leave first name blank; continue
Expected Result: First Name is required validation is shown

Title: Checkout requires last name
Steps: Start checkout; leave last name blank; continue
Expected Result: Last Name is required validation is shown

Title: Checkout requires postal code
Steps: Start checkout; leave postal code blank; continue
Expected Result: Postal Code is required validation is shown

Title: Checkout accepts valid customer data
Steps: Enter first name, last name and postal code; continue
Expected Result: Checkout overview displays item and totals

Title: Finish checkout successfully
Expected Result: Order confirmation message is displayed

Title: Back button after payment confirmation
Expected Result: No duplicate order is created; navigation behavior is safe and consistent

Title: Checkout special characters in name
Steps: Enter permitted punctuation or Unicode in name fields and continue
Expected Result: Input is handled safely; no broken layout or unhandled error

Title: Very long checkout input
Steps: Enter long strings in customer fields
Expected Result: Fields handle length safely without layout breakage

Title: Cart persists while navigating
Steps: Navigate inventory to cart and back
Expected Result: Cart contents remain consistent

Title: Logout from inventory
Expected Result: Login page is displayed and protected page is not accessible without login

Title: UI layout at narrow viewport
Steps: Resize viewport to mobile width and inspect login/inventory/cart
Expected Result: Controls remain visible and usable without unintended overlap
